$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for editor validation and autocomplete.

name.description: Base app name. Worktree prefix still applies.

script.description: Name of a package.json script to run.

appPort.description: Fixed port for the child process instead of auto-assignment.

proxy.description: Whether to route through the proxy. Auto-detected from the command; set false for non-server scripts.

turbo.description: Set false to use direct spawning instead of Turborepo in multi-app mode.

worktree.description: Worktree label style and hostname template. Root values are defaults for every app; apps entries override them by key.

apps.description: Overrides for workspace packages, keyed by relative path.

prefix.description: Worktree branch label style: last-segment uses the final '/' segment; branch keeps the full branch.

hostnameTemplate.description: Hostname template replacing the whole hostname; must contain {worktree} and may include {name}.

name.description: Base app name for this workspace package.

script.description: Name of a package.json script to run for this package.

appPort.description: Fixed port for this child process.

proxy.description: Whether to route this package through the proxy.

worktree.description: Per-app worktree label and hostname template overrides.
